title: Roof Pitch Calculator
seoTitle: Roof Pitch Calculator - Pitch to Degrees
metaDescription: Turn a rise and run, an angle, or rise per 12 inches into roof pitch (x/12), degrees, percent slope, and the area multiplier, with a 2024 IRC shingle check.
intent: Convert a measured rise and run (or an angle) into roof pitch (x/12), degrees, percent slope, and the area multiplier.
registerRow: Keyword register (estimates): roof pitch calculator, volume 2, competition ease 4, ad value 3, fit 5, priority 24. Trends ratio vs concrete calculator = 0.035.
intro: Enter a rise and run, an angle, or the rise over a 12 inch run. You get the pitch as x/12, the angle in degrees, the percent slope, and the multiplier that turns a flat footprint into true roof area. Measure from the attic or a gable end, not from the roof.
chartTitle: Roof angle in degrees at each pitch, 1/12 to 12/12
uniqueAddition: An always-visible pitch reference table from 1/12 to 12/12 (degrees, percent slope, area multiplier) plus a line chart of angle by pitch, and a low-slope check against 2024 IRC R905.2.2 and Table R905.1.1(2) shown under the results.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: What do you know?
inputs.help: Pick the measurement you have. Only the matching fields are shown.

inputs.name: rise
inputs.label: Rise
inputs.help: Vertical distance the roof climbs over your run, 0 to 36 in. In the attic, hold a level against the underside of a rafter and measure straight up to the rafter.

inputs.name: run
inputs.label: Run
inputs.help: Level horizontal distance you measured along, 1 to 24 in. A 12 in run gives the pitch directly.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.label: Angle
inputs.help: Roof angle from level, 0 to 75 degrees, e.g. from an angle finder or a phone level app.

inputs.name: pitchX
inputs.label: Rise per 12 in of run
inputs.help: The x in x/12, 0 to 24. For a 4/12 roof, enter 4.

inputs.name: footprint
inputs.label: Roof footprint area (optional)
inputs.help: Flat, bird's-eye area under the roof including overhangs, 0 to 20,000 sq ft. Leave at 0 to skip roof area.

outputs.name: rafterPerFoot
outputs.label: Rafter length per foot of run

sources.title: 2024 International Residential Code, Chapter 9 Roof Assemblies: R905.2.2 Slope and Table R905.1.1(2) (GSA Residential Code 2024, adopts the IRC 2024 without amendments), UpCodes
OSHA Fall Prevention Campaign (Occupational Safety and Health Administration)
